name: PAH3 s20 Bonus round 2
description:
Submods required for Bonus Round 2 of season 20 of the tournament and starting saves, more info in the pinned messages on this channel: https://discord.com/channels/298106089885401090/1096866734142656522 on the vcmi Discord server: https://discord.gg/chBT42V and in Polish in this thread in the Behemoth's Lair: http://imperium.heroes.net.pl/temat/5479
All heroes banned except for one.
Added multiple copies of that one hero (one-hero mode).
Everyone does 50% more damage from behind.
Upkeep cost: every creature costs some gold each day. Level 1 creatures cost 1 gold each, level 2 creatures cost 2 gold, level 3 creatures cost 4 etc. Level 7 creatures cost 64 gold each.
